ValidationRule.description: When the status of the coupon is changed, user needs to enter the date field specific to that status
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Distributed"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Coupon_Distributed_Date__c)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Issued"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Coupon_Issued_Date__c)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Used"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Coupon_Used_Date__c)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Issued but Voided"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Coupon_Issued_but_Voided_Date__c)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Unissued but Voided"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Coupon_Unissued_but_Voided_Date__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the date corresponding to the status.
